name: ohos-nginx-embedded
title: OHOS native nginx via embedded shared library
description: Make the HarmonyOS build install and run native Nginx by switching from executableBinaryPaths exec to the embedded shared-library lifecycle already used on iOS, verified on the real device.
creator: lichengyu
